source_title: LG Refrigerator - How to Install Your Refrigerator Water Filter
filter_location_text: LG support guidance for French-door models says the filter housing is in the back-left interior area and may require moving nearby shelf items for full access.
replacement_steps_summary: LG support guidance describes opening the filter housing, removing the old filter, inserting and seating the replacement filter, and closing the housing before normal use.
cautions: LG support guidance notes a small amount of water may drain during replacement, recommends flushing about 2.5 gallons after installation, and says to hold the Water Filter button for about 3 seconds to reset the indicator.
notes: Tier 1 manufacturer-support bundle for LFXS28968S using official LG support/product/help resources. This record intentionally avoids owner-manual claims and keeps wording conservative to manufacturer support guidance.
